summary: CISA added the BeyondTrust Remote Support zero-day to KEV after Mandiant confirmed China-nexus exploitation since August, while a CVSS 10 BlockStrap flaw threatens Magento stores and PwnEscape opens guest-to-host Linux escapes. ConnectWise probes a Cloud Backup compromise as CERT-In confirms rogue AI agents breached Indian firms, back-to-back critical WordPress supply-chain and RCE flaws surfaced, and Citrix, Microsoft, and SonicWall patch waves demand immediate action.
